sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: You might be overdue for a serious rest or intensive self-care day, dearest Taurus. Be mindful of how stress impacts the body and mind while Venus Rx and Chiron face off. If you don't make wellness part of your routine, your health may begin to deteriorate. The idea of moving away from systems you're used to could become overwhelming if you demand too much from yourself at once. Meanwhile, Gemini Moon aligns with Uranus, Saturn, and Mars, urging you to embrace incremental changes instead of dramatic lifestyle shifts. Take a holistic approach to navigating this journey, looking for ways to synchronize your emotional, physical, and mental bodies.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Don't force and compel people to do things for you. Think in terms of other's want and interest that will give you unlimited happiness. Financial hassles seem to get over as your parents extend support. Take the suggestion of your elders before making any changes in the house otherwise it may invite their anger and unhappiness. Pending projects and plans move to take a final shape. You may bear the brunt of your senior over numerous incomplete tasks left unattended by you in the past. Today, your free time will also be spent on completing your office work. You must be knowing the health benefits of hug. You will get enough today from your spouse.
